web.notes: Operator console for the multi-ai-router (SolidJS SPA), dev stack via bin/dev with a SEEDED throwaway database: 3 accounts (one anthropic-api with a 118-char label, one openai-api, one ollama pointed at a dead localhost port), 1 weighted pool, 1 router key. All credentials are fake — upstream calls fail on purpose; error statuses, cooldown lines and 'needs reauth' states are EXPECTED, not bugs. The theme follows the OS preference — headless Chrome renders light, which is CORRECT. Sign-in uses the local password form (the OIDC button may also render; ignore it). Safe-area / notch behavior cannot be judged in headless Chrome — do not report it.
